title: Gravlax
description: A traditional dish from Sweden, centered on salmon, sea salt, dill, lemon. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Cured salmon is not cooked: use only fish supplied as suitable for raw consumption by a reputable vendor; curing does not eliminate foodborne hazards. Not suitable for vulnerable diners.

steps.instruction: Use salmon sold for raw consumption. Remove pin bones, mix salt, sugar, dill and pepper and coat the fillet evenly. Keep the fish cold.
Cover and cure the fish in the refrigerator at or below 4°C for 48 hours; turn it occasionally. Curing alone does not make ordinary raw fish safe.
Brush away the excess cure and slice the chilled salmon thinly with a clean knife.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
